::: {.hero} # Research updates, project notes, and useful links This site is a compact Quarto starter you can publish on GitHub Pages and extend with project pages, notes, and reports. - Write pages in `.qmd` - Preview locally with `quarto preview` - Publish automatically from GitHub Actions ::: ## What this site can hold ::: {.grid} ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4} ### Project updates Short posts or notes about what you are working on. ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4} ### Documentation Methods, workflows, and supporting explanations. ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4} ### Results Figures, tables, and summaries from analyses. ::: ::: ## How to publish 1. Commit the files to the `main` branch. 2. Push the repository to GitHub. 3. Enable GitHub Pages for the `gh-pages` branch, or let the workflow deploy it. 4. Keep editing the `.qmd` files and push again.
